notes.title: Optimization patch - Carbonflesh Demo
notes.notes:
Hello there! 

Its been a couple of week since the demo released, and a lot has happened since then, so I wanted to bring you up to speed. 

Firstly, allow me to thank you for your invaluable and constructive feedback on the demo which has been a huge help for us. 

Secondly, we have started to work on your feedback - with the first thing to be addressed is the game's optimization:
At the time of writing this blog post, the newest build on Steam should have a 30%- 60% bump in frames per second (depending on your PC), accompanied with at least 50%-80% less loading time when you start a new game. It took James and I, a while to figure out what was causing these issues and while some work is still to be done, we remedied a big chunk of the slowdown without sacrificing visual clarity. 

Our goal is to have a final game that is both optimized and performant to the best of our abilities and tech we are using. 

Finally, a huge thank you for all your support! I just got of a call with James and we are still astounded by the sheer amount of positive comments from all sides! 

No idea how to put it. I'm just happy and smiling all day long. 

On the next blog post I aim to have something more "behind the scenes". 
Until then, check out the build and let me know if the changes worked for you. 

  
Cheers!
- George "Zok" Zokas

notes.title: Demo Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello there! 

Carbonflesh is getting a free playable demo and a trailer on Friday July 19th on Steam! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2191720/Carbonflesh/

What you can expect from the demo
A narrative experience with a thick atmosphere inspired by 80's and 90's movies, along with a nostalgia drenched synth soundtrack.
Sims-like gameplay, hacking in a clicker style and easy mouse only controls.
45 minutes length- depending on your playstyle, and 19 Steam Achievements.
This is a game about smart decisions, not reflexes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125776/4068a0a8eaa3ad5654541e027aa7e2b89bec85ae.png
This is the first chapter (or tape 1 as we refer to it internally) of the complete game with some minor changes.  

Carbonflesh was made to be a chill experience, having a coffee or whiskey in one hand and the mouse in the other, so don’t stress, be smart - you got this!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125776/a6200647560f2396c740bfe7dd602539b56e3919.png
Hope you enjoy the demo, leave us any feedback you have on the in-game feedback form and share it with anyone you think will like it! 

Cheers, see ya on the 19th!
- George "Zok" Zokas, Game Designer
